name: bulwark
description: Bulwark: a shield for self-hosted gateways. Blocklists, payload detection and bans on every request in microseconds; full request logs, wave warnings, pattern graphs and vendor reporting in its own dashboard.
author: Alexd Aero

scripts.check: for f in core/*.mjs sensor/*.mjs server.mjs public/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && for f in bin/bulwark forge/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done
